name: code
description: Tools that act on a codebase — a senior code-reviewer agent, a feedback-loop-first diagnosing-bugs skill, and two paired codebase commands split by what they change: /code-sweep for implementations (driven by the code-smells catalog) and /refactor-interfaces for interfaces and seams (driven by the codebase-design vocabulary), each auditing before touching anything — /code-sweep into a severity-tiered defect list, /refactor-interfaces into a visual Artifact report.
